ai_overview.answer_markdown:
If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Wyndham Vale (VIC 3024)**, you have several good options:

- **Local locksmiths** that install and configure smart locks (Yale, Lockwood, Aqara, Eufy, Philips, Samsung, etc.). [www.auslock.com.au](https://www.auslock.com.au/pages/locksmith/wyndham-vale?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Airtasker**, where experienced installers in the Wyndham Vale area regularly complete smart lock installations. Recent jobs have included installing Aqara, mortise smart locks, and digital deadbolts. Typical installation-only pricing in the area is around **A$100–A$200**, depending on the lock type and whether door modifications are required. [www.airtasker.com](https://www.airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/wyndham-vale-vic/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Installation costs typically are:
- **Simple replacement** (existing deadbolt): **A$100–A$150**
- **New smart mortise lock or door modifications**: **A$150–A$300+**
- Extra charges may apply if the installer needs to enlarge holes, chisel the door, or adjust the strike plate. [www.airtasker.com](https://www.airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/wyndham-vale-vic/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you already have a smart lock, tell me:
1. **The brand and model** (e.g. Yale Assure, Aqara U100/U200, Eufy E330, Lockwood 001 Touch Plus).
2. Whether it's for a **timber front door**, **security screen door**, or another type of door.

I can also let you know if it's likely to be a straightforward installation or if your door will need modifications.
